productUrls.title: Direct eBay Item URLs
productUrls.description: List of direct eBay listing URLs (e.g. https://www.ebay.com/itm/123456789012). Leave empty to search by keywords.

searchKeywords.title: Search Keywords
searchKeywords.description: Keywords to search on eBay (e.g. 'iPhone 15 Pro Max', 'Pokemon booster box', 'Nike Dunk Low').

soldItemsOnly.title: Sold & Completed Items Only (Arbitrage Mode)
soldItemsOnly.description: Filter to extract ONLY items that were actually completed and sold, revealing true historical market sales prices.

listingType.title: Listing Format
listingType.description: Filter by buying format: Buy It Now (Fixed Price), Auction, or All.

ebayDomain.title: Regional eBay Marketplace
ebayDomain.description: Select the target regional eBay domain.

maxProducts.title: Max Products Per Search
maxProducts.description: Maximum number of listing records to extract per keyword.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: eBay enforces strict anti-bot gating (Pardon Our Interruption) on datacenter IPs. Select Apify RESIDENTIAL or UNBLOCKER proxy group for reliable extraction.
